instructions: Acquire the original selected execution results through the original handoff. Choose bounded status or requested file/page reads using actual preceding outcomes. Preserve partial bytes and native scores. Native paths expose the current resource filesystem: the exact attempt observation does not establish that current file bytes were produced by that attempt. Separate read windows are not an atomic file snapshot. The scientific parent interprets the returned records. Original work, resource and selector stay fixed. Only actual complete acquisition establishes this endpoint. Tool-specific and resource instructions are available through knowledge.search, knowledge.entry and knowledge.read. The tool_knowledge context identifies the run-frozen library. Retrieve sections when useful; these instructions do not select work, supply scientific evidence or add execution capabilities. Use the actual tool schemas and caller-owned configuration for execution. Knowledge reads use line coordinates, not scientific source-byte anchors. No manual read is mandatory. Launch software/resource instructions have their own run-frozen library: launch.instructions.search, launch.instructions.entry, launch.instructions.read and launch.instructions.select. The launch_instruction_library context gives its identity. Select any relevant sections from one or several entries; pass the returned selection as launch_instructions in the child assignment. selected_launch_instructions contains exact sections already selected for this assignment. Instructions describe ways to work; they do not select resources, enable tools, override caller constraints, establish current availability or supply scientific evidence. Inventory and fresh observations remain separate. No instruction read or selection is mandatory.

changed_annotation_refs.meaning: Actual changed annotation revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_assessment_refs.meaning: Actual changed assessment revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_interpretation_account_refs.meaning: Actual changed episode-owned coherent interpretation accounts; these are not parent annotation revisions.

changed_record_refs.meaning: New or revised semantic records explicitly identified as changed by recorded work.

committed_record_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by completed own work and completed child investigations.

credit.meaning: Projected credit at child completion for its fixed assigned scope; redelivery preserves that snapshot.

episode_yield.meaning: Recorded closing local numerical forecast and continuation decision, in the child's configured controller units. It is not task credit, a job ETA, a parent instruction or goal completion. Null when the controller does not expose the supported typed numerical state. Normal status is 0; -1 means insufficient observations and -2 means unidentifiable, not negative predicted gain.

completed_actions.description: Completed own actions at this child's level; an investigation commissioned by it counts once.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

execution.blast_utility_artifacts.meaning: Only explicitly selected original artifact occurrences and their byte identities.

execution.blast_utility_checks.meaning: Selected and relevant global original utility validation observations.

execution.blast_utility_database_fields.meaning: Requested native database fields with exact source locators, units and qualifications.

field_name.description: Native reported integer average in that population.
Native reported integer average in that population.

execution.blast_utility_failures.meaning: Original typed utility failures and necessary qualifications.

execution.blast_utility_integrity.meaning: Requested observed native integrity scope and measurements, never inferred coverage.

execution.blast_utility_missing.meaning: Exact requested selections unavailable from the retained utility result.

ordinal.description: Select one original ordinal, or null explicitly for all occurrences of this direction and role.
Select one original ordinal, or null explicitly for all occurrences of this direction and role.

execution.blast_utility_path_sections.meaning: Selected original path sections distinguish reported empty populations from absent reports.

execution.blast_utility_paths.meaning: Selected literal native path rows and declared dependency ordinals; paths confer no byte access.

execution.blast_utility_preparation.meaning: Requested original database preparation facts, without scientific confidence.

execution.blast_utility_prepared_databas.meaning: Explicitly requested existing prepared database manifest or qualified unavailability.

execution.blast_utility_saved_data.meaning: Only explicitly selected retained utility result or available prepared manifest artifacts.

execution.blast_utility_sequences.meaning: Selected original extracted identities, sequences, native lengths and returned coordinates.

execution.blast_utility_status.meaning: Requested delivery, original native outcome and capture completeness are distinct.

execution.blast_utility_vdb_context.meaning: Explicitly selected supplied VDB context and missing identity qualifications, without metadata byte grants.

execution.masking_artifacts.meaning: Only explicitly requested original artifact occurrences.

execution.masking_checks.meaning: Selected-record and relevant global saved validation checks.

execution.masking_failures.meaning: Retained typed failures relevant to this selected preparation result.

execution.masking_quantities.meaning: Exact requested shared masking components; no function confidence.

execution.masking_saved_data.meaning: Only explicitly requested immutable shared sheets, components or parsed statistics.

execution.masking_statistics.meaning: Requested original WindowMasker native statistics and provenance.

execution.masking_status.meaning: Recorded native state and selected preparation result availability.

execution_blast_hsps.meaning: Optional explicitly requested native measurements for all published HSPs of this acquired result. No automatic ranking, top-N or significance filter. target_coverage is native reference/hit coverage, not original gene-target coverage. HSP/reference records support later scoped reads; selected HSP references can instead be returned through a parent-chosen typed field. No functional assignment or annotation score.

execution_bvbrc_counts.meaning: Native matching-document counts with their exact population and availability.

execution_bvbrc_expression_rows.meaning: Selected molecular measurements with recorded result, bioset, experiment and feature relationships.

execution_bvbrc_facets.meaning: Native field buckets and saved fractions of the same response's exact document population.

execution_bvbrc_feature_sequence_rows.meaning: Selected feature occurrences and their recorded AA/NA sequence associations.

execution_bvbrc_numeric_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native rows, numerical measurements and source metadata cells.

execution_bvbrc_pages.meaning: Selected retained response and page coverage; document counts are acquisition metadata.

execution_completed.meaning: Whether this assignment has actual verified endpoint information. Generic native results mean requested current-filesystem acquisition plus independently observed successful exact execution, without a producing-attempt or atomic-version claim. RNA results mean complete requested original-bundle or retained-sheet delivery, including specific unavailable values; this does not assert native success. Yielding alone is false.

execution_handoff_refs.meaning: Qualified original handoff sources actually available to this episode, including authenticated original failed native database or RNA attempts for partial-output acquisition; failed attempts do not establish a successful native endpoint.

execution_hmmalign_sequence_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_hmmer_domain_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_nhmmer_locus_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_protein_structure_failures.meaning: Recorded structured protein result failure with original identity; no model-authored finding.

execution_protein_structure_projections.meaning: Exactly selected protein structure values or an exact selected-table descriptor; equality is checked against the original result record.

execution_protein_structure_saved_sheets.meaning: Original saved numerical-sheet descriptor with explicitly granted uses; descriptor receipt is not receipt of unselected values.

execution_protein_structure_sequences.meaning: Original structure-derived sequence descriptor and explicit downstream uses; original record equality and authority are checked separately.

execution_result_origin.meaning: Actual acquisition semantics of retained results: current-file windows, original producer output, or explicitly received saved numerical data. ATAC records distinguish captured original occurrences from received sheet/table bundles and do not imply native success. No qualified retained data yields null. RNA failed native attempts and saved-sheet recalculations return null even when qualified delivery completes.

execution_result_refs.meaning: Qualified actual requested result acquisitions available to this episode. Generic native windows retain current-filesystem observations. Explicit BLAST/HMMER/Infernal/RNA producer bundles retain original attempt outputs matched by digest and requested numerical facts. RNA source delivery alone grants no auxiliary artifacts or unrequested rows.

fluorescence_contexts.meaning: Requested definitions associated with the selected numerical page; provenance identities do not grant source access.

fluorescence_failures.meaning: Recorded located input, capture, worker, and projection failures.

fluorescence_measurements.meaning: Requested saved fluorescence numerical cells with their actual units, populations, denominators, and qualifications.

fluorescence_saved_sheets.meaning: Explicitly returned common numerical-sheet identity for a separately selected recalculation.

flux_balance_failures.meaning: Recorded located FBA selection, capture, parse, calculation and return failures; no model-composed findings.

flux_balance_measurements.meaning: Explicitly selected FBA native and calculated molecular model measurements, with original positions, populations, units and missing-data qualifications; no annotation probability.

flux_balance_saved_sheets.meaning: Explicitly requested saved numerical-sheet identities for later selected recalculation; no grant of native or prior-source artifacts.

interpretation_basis_refs.meaning: Semantic references visible to the last admitted report interpretation response and available at this report boundary, including source-window custody and admitted typed forms. A visible handle does not establish that its full record or source body was read.

last_outcome_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by the last completed own ordinary action.

observations_after_report_basis.meaning: Last ordinary-action observations not supplied to that interpretation response.

pending_handles.meaning: Original selected child executions still pending when this episode closed. These handles survive parent closure; closure does not cancel them or establish scientific completion.

subject_refs.meaning: Original input subjects assigned by the parent.

goal.objective: Recalculate the selected reaction quantities from the received sheet with explicit parameters and positions.

task_context.root_objective: Test the supplied candidate reaction hypothesis in the synthetic IN/AB/OUT model by setting both bounds of the parent-corresponding AB reaction to zero, retaining the model objective. Return the requested native and calculated model quantities, their unavailable units and qualifications; these predictions are conditional on the supplied model and are not observed fluxes or annotation probabilities.

context.report_lifecycle: Interpretations are the last actual reasoning basis; later tool outcomes are facts, not a new judgment.
context.requested_report_purpose: Return the requested typed measurements with their original numerical meanings and custody.

scientific_child_credit_binding.meaning: Caller-injected projector; no default scientific policy or denominator is inferred.

tools.description: Record the selected original FBA attempt or explicitly received saved-sheet status.
tools.name: execution.results.status

tools.description: Collect the selected closed FBA output or calculate the explicitly received saved sheet and return the requested measurements.
tools.name: execution.results.collect

tools.description: Search/page the run-frozen tool-instruction index. All whitespace-separated query terms must occur in entry metadata, case-insensitively; this is literal discovery, not a scientific suitability verdict. Empty query lists entries. No manual bodies are loaded.
tools.name: knowledge.search

tools.description: Read one instruction entry's section index, tool names and provenance without loading manual bodies. A listed tool is not necessarily enabled for this episode.
tools.name: knowledge.entry

tools.description: Read a selected instruction section by zero-based line offset and line count. Follow next_query for more. Returns run library identity and exact section digest; instructions are not scientific source evidence.
tools.name: knowledge.read

tools.description: Search/page the separate run-frozen launch instruction metadata. Empty query browses entries. resource_kind is an optional exact metadata filter; neither matches nor manuals establish resource availability.
tools.name: launch.instructions.search

tools.description: Read one launch instruction entry index, sources and section hashes without loading section text. Listed operations still require an actual binding.
tools.name: launch.instructions.entry

tools.description: Read exact zero-based line windows from a selected launch instruction section. Returns its digest and next_query; reading performs no setup or execution.
tools.name: launch.instructions.read

tools.description: Pin explicitly selected sections from one or multiple entries in this run-frozen launch library. Pass the returned selection as the child assignment launch_instructions. Does not choose or launch a resource.
tools.name: launch.instructions.select

tools.description: Read only this Episode's prior decisions: metadata index, exact selected actions/outcomes and admitted direct-child forms, or a bounded publication-ID page from one prior own action. Failed outcomes remain failed. This ordinary read never executes old work or reads child-private conversations.

limit.description: Requested page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size), so disabling automatic previews still permits an ordinary page to advance. Omit when selecting decision_indices.

offset.description: Position in this Episode's ordered prior-decision page; omit when selecting decision_indices.

limit.description: Requested publication-ID page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size).

offset.description: Position in the actual saved publication-ID array for this one prior own action.

tools.name: episode.history
